method: Selected source semantics, not full external provider/SDK conformance audit

providers.name: Codex
providers.transport: External Codex app-server; generated JSON-RPC requests/notifications/server requests over child stdio.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust protocol codec plus process/session owner; reuse installed Codex executable.
providers.blocker: T3 does not need a first-party JS SDK for this observed transport. Protocol generated schemas are patched in upstream, so generated-only implementation is insufficient.
semantics: Native thread fork/rollback, multi-turn goals, asynchronous questions, approvals and MCP elicitation, background work, strong IDs.

providers.name: Claude Code
providers.transport: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query/session APIs; SDK spawns installed Claude Code process; T3 supplies process spawning/cleanup and callbacks.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust Claude control-protocol client plus settings/hooks/transcript/session implementation; installed provider executable remains external.
providers.blocker: Full parity is unproven. Retaining JS SDK bridge is only an interim stage. T3 consumes forkSession/getSessionMessages/getSubagentMessages/resolveSettings and Query control methods beyond basic streamed prompt output.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.transport: T3 NDJSON worker calls @cursor/sdk Agent/createAgentPlatform and @cursor/sdk/sqlite; first-party JS/native modules and patched SDK hooks.
providers.rust_replacement: A native Cursor API/protocol/storage client with proven parity, or a vendor-supported native SDK. Opaque external engine boundary must be explicit.
providers.blocker: Highest observed blocker. Current IPC is T3-owned TS worker, not evidence of a stable Cursor external agent protocol. Native shell hooks and content-addressed checkpoint rewind require additional parity research. Third-party SDK internals/license not audited.
semantics: Shared worker already avoids SDK baseline per session; refcounted workspace SQLite store; hook-based agent shell output/background shells; resume/summarize/steer; rewind via exact checkpoint blobs; no native fork.

providers.name: ACP Registry / generic ACP
providers.transport: External registry-selected process using ACP JSON-RPC and negotiated client/agent capabilities.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust shared ACP runtime and catalog/install/auth/launch policy plus flavor interface.
providers.blocker: Do not hardcode provider-ID behavior into generic adapter. Some registry executables/wrappers are themselves JS or proprietary external providers; all-Rust T3 does not rewrite them.
semantics: Model/options may arrive later; permission option IDs retained; generic rollback via new session and kept-history replay differs native rollback; registry Copilot cancellation disables interrupt/restart steering.

providers.name: Grok
providers.transport: Grok-specific ACP flavor over shared runtime.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust ACP plus Grok protocol/steering/history normalization.
providers.blocker: Flavor behavior cannot be replaced by generic ACP alone.
semantics: Active interjection waits current tool; cancel kills foreground process; explicit stop restarts process group; no native fork.

providers.name: fx
providers.transport: fx-specific ACP flavor over shared runtime.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust ACP plus fx history/tool/subagent normalization.
providers.blocker: Capability defaults overridden by flavor and handshake.
semantics: Model switch, readable snapshots, MCP and subagents.

providers.name: Kiro
providers.transport: Kiro-specific ACP flavor, private steering/fork metadata and hook negotiation.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust ACP plus exact Kiro extensions.
providers.blocker: Version-sensitive extension behavior must be replayed against actual provider binaries.
semantics: Fork at prompt metadata; steering waits tools and excludes attachments; Kiro V3 hook opt-in version v2.

providers.name: Antigravity
providers.transport: Antigravity ACP flavor with profile-scoped process/auth and file-read repair.
providers.blocker: Cannot advertise native conversation rollback just because shared ACP supports portable replay. Child session IDs absent, children read-only.
semantics: Session model/runtime changes, native goals dynamic, HTTP MCP where negotiated, post-settle continuation/background work, native file-read repair.

providers.name: Pi
providers.transport: Installed Pi CLI JSON RPC mode; native extension/package/trust behavior retained.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust line-RPC client plus Pi session/history/fork/policy adapter.
providers.blocker: Native fork CLI destination cwd differs RPC session switch; cannot flatten this distinction.
semantics: Native session history/fork; immutable permission hook requires restart on runtime mode change; active steering; no strong native turn IDs.

providers.name: OpenCode 1
providers.transport: External HTTP agent server plus event subscription; per-thread chat server with directory-scoped MCP.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust HTTP/event client plus OpenCode 1 lifecycle and policy adapter.
providers.blocker: Do not substitute OpenCode 2 API/lifecycle. External servers remain externally owned.
semantics: Shared idle helper for catalog/text generation; project-scope always approvals translated so full access remains once; per-thread directory/MCP.

providers.name: OpenCode 2
providers.transport: @opencode/client/effect HTTP client and SSE decoder against external server; single server per instance across directories.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust HTTP/SSE client and protocol schemas; no inherent JS business-logic requirement from this observed transport.
providers.blocker: Schema evolution and unreadable start/end events handled explicitly. Subscribe before work since stream is volatile.
semantics: Basic auth user opencode; per-thread MCP names and deny-other-thread permissions; session approval once plus T3 session rule; external server ownership.

providers.name: Muse
providers.transport: @muse-code/sdk spawnMspConnection launches external muse serve; MSP command/request/notification/server-request API and initialize schema v1.
providers.rust_replacement: Rust MSP transport/codec and process owner, retaining installed Muse executable.
providers.blocker: SDK implementation not audited; T3-visible envelope/protocol gives clearer replacement boundary than Cursor. Must preserve command identity and capability handshake.
semantics: Session MCP negotiation; no native rollback/fork/resume; synthetic user handoff; canonical/Windows verbatim paths; process start timeout and cancellation wait for shutdown; Linux env trampoline already present.
